title: Instant Neural Graphics Primitives with a Multiresolution Hash Encoding
abstract: Neural graphics primitives, such as neural radiance fields and signed distance functions, require minutes to hours of optimization. We introduce a multiresolution hash encoding of input coordinates implemented on CUDA. By training a tiny two-layer MLP, our system achieves peak signal-to-noise ratio in seconds, synthesizing novel photorealistic views of 3D scenes without 3D geometric meshes.
